research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Treasure Data is focused on developing advanced data management and analytics solutions. Their research includes distributed data processing using embedded hermetic and deterministic languages, which enhances data processing efficiency. They are also working on data type-based visual profiling of large-scale database tables, allowing for better data visualization and management. Additionally, they are exploring accelerated automatic creation of data transformations, which streamlines data processing workflows. These efforts highlight Treasure Data's commitment to improving cloud-based data analytics platforms.

product_launches.description: Treasure Data launched its AI Agent Foundry, now available in the new AWS Marketplace AI Agents and Tools category, enabling enterprises to build and deploy custom AI agents for customer data workflows.

Treasure Data has launched five new AI Suites—Personalization AI Suite, Engagement AI Suite, Creative AI Suite, Service AI Suite, and Paid Media AI Suite—designed to help companies leverage agentic AI for marketing, customer experience, and service operations. Additionally, Treasure Data introduced a Migration Agent to facilitate easier migration from legacy CDPs.

about_short_description.short_description: Treasure Data is a software development company that develops a cloud-based data analytics platform for data management.

product.name: Treasure AI Agentic Experience Platform
product.description: An AI-driven platform that combines customer data, intelligence, marketing automation, and campaign execution in a unified environment.

product.name: Treasure AI Intelligent CDP
product.description: A customer data platform that unifies customer data, resolves identities, applies AI-based intelligence, and supports real-time segmentation, decisioning, and activation.

product.name: Treasure AI Studio
product.description: A conversational AI workspace that lets users explore customer data and build segments, journeys, workflows, reports, and dashboards using natural language.

product.name: Treasure AI Suites
product.description: A set of AI-enabled activation solutions for customer engagement, personalization, creative production, paid media, and customer service.

product.name: Engagement AI Suite
product.description: An omnichannel engagement solution for creating messages, orchestrating customer journeys, applying predictive signals, and activating campaigns across email, mobile, in-app, SMS, and paid channels.

product.name: Personalization AI Suite
product.description: An AI-powered personalization solution that selects and optimizes web content, offers, and digital experiences using real-time customer context and behavioral signals.
